definitions.explanation: To move something back and forth against a surface with pressure.
To brush or scrape lightly against something while passing.

examples.japanese: {目|め}を{擦|こす}ってはいけません。
{壁|かべ}に{車|くるま}を{擦|こす}ってしまった。
examples.english: I scraped the car against the wall.

examples.japanese: たわしで{鍋|なべ}を{擦|こす}って{汚|よご}れを{落|お}とした。
examples.english: I scrubbed the pot with a scrub brush to remove the stains.

examples.japanese: {背中|せなか}を{擦|こす}ってくれる？
マッチを{擦|こす}って{火|ひ}をつけた。
examples.english: I struck a match to light a fire.

examples.japanese: {電柱|でんちゅう}に{車|くるま}を{擦|こす}った。
examples.english: I scraped the car against a utility pole.

examples.japanese: ドアに{腕|うで}を{擦|こす}った。
examples.english: I scraped my arm on the door.

examples.japanese: {石|いし}に{靴|くつ}を{擦|こす}ってしまった。
examples.english: I scraped my shoes against a rock.

examples.japanese: {肌|はだ}を{強|つよ}く{擦|こす}らないで。
examples.english: Don't scrub your skin too hard.

examples.japanese: {狭|せま}い{道|みち}でミラーを{擦|こす}った。
examples.english: I scraped the mirror on a narrow road.

notes:
{擦|こす}る is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) meaning to rub or scrub with friction.

INTRANSITIVE: {擦|こす}れる (to rub against, to become worn)

ASPECT (ている):
{擦|こす}っている indicates the rubbing action is ongoing.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [body part]を{擦|こす}る — to rub [body part]
- [object]を[surface]に{擦|こす}る — to scrape [object] against [surface]
- [thing]で{擦|こす}る — to scrub with [thing]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {目|め}を{擦|こす}る (rub one's eyes)
- {背中|せなか}を{擦|こす}る (scrub one's back)
- マッチを{擦|こす}る (strike a match)
- {車|くるま}を{擦|こす}る (scrape a car)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as こする.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {揉|も}む: to knead, massage (more pressing)
- {擦|こす}る: to rub, scrub (more friction)
- {撫|な}でる: to stroke (gentle, one direction)
